context:
Goal: one writing standard in every repo.
Problem (rule): q_max and degen still require STE, and work in another repo needs your word.
Based on (ruling): your 13:22 CST pick b (Nov 2), "drop STE everywhere".
Based on (read, Nov 5): #1105 merged Nov 2; joyous's CLAUDE.md no longer names STE; q_max CLAUDE.md (Language standard) and degen CLAUDE.md (rule prose-is-ste) still do.
Departs from: q_max's and degen's CLAUDE.md, which require STE — a points them at rule output-write-in-ste instead.
holds: Only the child repos' STE lines; #1105 goes ahead without it.

lastAnswer.note: more importantly why do those repos have their own claude md thst holds a lot of repetition? Lane child-claude-md-dedupe surveys that first.

options.how: A lane in each child repo replaces its STE lines with a pointer to the parent rule.
options.label: Change them too
options.lose: Four small lanes in other repos.

options.how: Only claude-settings drops the STE name.
options.label: Leave the child repos
options.lose: The child repos keep a rule the parent dropped.

ref: decision plain-prose-lint; draft PR #1105; child repos q_max, banchi, degen, joyous
title: Should the other repos' CLAUDE.md files also drop Simplified Technical English?
why: Your 13:22 CST ruling said "everywhere". q_max, banchi, degen and joyous still name STE in their own CLAUDE.md files, and changing them is work in other repos.
